task.title: Adjusting repository visibility by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To control who can pull or interact with a repository, you can adjust its visibility to public or private by using the Red Hat Quay UI.

step.cmd: On the Red Hat Quay UI, click Repositories in the navigation pane.
Click the name of a repository.
Click Settings in the navigation pane.
Click Make private. The repository is made private, and only users on the permissions list can view and interact with it.
